finalText:
**Build now passes.** Two real bugs, not noise.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`. The bump renamed it `retryCount`. [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) takes both now. `isBackoffEnabled` threw on an unset flag. [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) treats `undefined` as off.

The 8 warnings remain. `build.js` prints them as fixed strings. They name deps, not our code.

Next: nothing, unless you want those deps chased upstream.
